**Finding: missing — § 3.5 Effect of Termination (medium severity)**

The agreement contains no exit or data-return mechanism. § 3.5 addresses only accrued payment obligations; § 11.6 puts Content responsibility on us without any retrieval right; § 14.18 covers only contact information; § 14.2 merely preserves § 3.5. For a hosted services agreement this is walk-away territory (no data return at all).

Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted: inserted the preferred exit clause after p0049 — six months' transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of Content in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter, with 90 days of assistance flagged as our fallback.
